sections.name: 3. The Problem / Reframe
sections.title: Your product photo is doing more than showing what you sell.
paragraphs: Before someone reads your product description, compares specifications, or asks a question, they may already have seen your product image.
A plain photo can show the item. But it may leave the viewer with little sense of how it fits into their life, what makes it appealing, or why they should take a closer look.
sections.listLead: The right visual presentation gives you more ways to communicate:

items.title: Show the product at its best.
items.text: Give its shape, details, and important features the attention they deserve.

items.title: Make the benefit easier to picture.
items.text: Use a visual concept that helps people understand what the product is for and why it may matter to them.

items.title: Create a stronger first impression.
items.text: Present your product with a more considered visual style instead of relying on an ordinary snapshot.

items.title: Give your advertising more creative options.
items.text: Use different visual approaches to explore different customer motivations.

items.title: Keep your content moving.
items.text: Get help with the creative work instead of having to produce every image and caption yourself.

sections.closingNote: A better-looking image does not automatically mean more sales. But a product image that communicates clearly and presents the product thoughtfully gives your advertising a stronger piece of creative to work with.

sections.name: 4. Different Reasons. Different Creative Possibilities.
sections.title: What do you want your product content to do?
sections.intro: There isn't one reason every customer buys. And there isn't one visual approach that suits every product or audience.
sections.intro2: Choose the direction that matches what matters to your customers.

items.title: Make your product feel more premium
items.lead: When presentation matters, the details matter.
items.text: Use considered composition, lighting, color, and styling to give your product a more polished visual presentation — while keeping the product itself recognizable.
items.fit: Your product competes partly on design, perceived quality, gifting appeal, or brand presentation.

items.title: Make people stop and look
items.lead: A product image has to compete with everything else on the screen.
items.text: A more distinctive visual concept can give the viewer a reason to pause and take a closer look.
items.fit: You want more creative variety for social posts, paid ads, or promotional campaigns.

items.title: Make the product easier to understand
items.lead: Some products need more than a clean pack shot. Customers may need to understand a feature, use case, or practical benefit.
items.text: Use the image and accompanying copy to make the important point easier to grasp.
items.fit: Your product has features or benefits that are difficult to communicate through a basic product photo alone.

items.title: Give your advertising more angles to test
items.lead: Different customers may care about different things. One person may respond to convenience; another may care about appearance, comfort, performance, or identity.
items.text: Create different creative directions around different, truthful product benefits and customer motivations.
items.fit: You want a range of advertising concepts rather than repeating the same message and visual treatment.

items.title: Build a more consistent product presentation
items.lead: When your products appear across a store, website, and social channels, inconsistent visuals can make the overall presentation feel disconnected.
items.text: Create images and copy with a more consistent direction across the content you order.
items.fit: You have several products or need content for more than one marketing channel.

items.title: Get the creative work off your to-do list
items.lead: You may already know what you want to sell. Finding the time to plan, create, edit, and write every product asset is another job.
items.text: Send us the product information and the materials you have. We'll handle the agreed creative work.
items.fit: You want help producing product visuals and copy without doing every part yourself.

sections.importantNote: We create the creative materials. Advertising performance also depends on factors such as the offer, audience, price, landing page, campaign setup, and market conditions. We do not promise a particular click-through rate or sales result.

sections.name: 5. What We Create
sections.title: Choose only what you need — or combine the pieces.
sections.intro: Order individual creative assets or pair visuals and copy together.

items.title: Product Advertising Image
items.lead: A product visual designed for a specific advertising or promotional purpose.
items.text: We use your product photo and brief to create a designed advertising image with an intentional visual concept, composition, and presentation.
items.receive: One finished product advertising image in JPG or PNG format.

items.title: Facebook & Instagram Ad Caption
items.lead: Give the image a message to work with.
items.text: Get an advertising caption built around your product, its meaningful benefits, the customer's perspective, and a clear reason to consider it.
items.text2: The goal is not to stuff the caption with hype. It is to help the right reader understand why the product may be relevant to them.
items.receive: One advertising caption in an editable text document.

items.title: Product Description
items.lead: Help shoppers understand what the product offers.
items.text: Turn product details into clear, customer-relevant copy. Explain important features, connect them to practical benefits, and help shoppers understand whether the product fits what they are looking for.
items.receive: One product description in DOC or TXT format.

items.title: Facebook & Instagram Ad Package
items.lead: One image and one caption, created to work together.
items.text: Get a product advertising image paired with an advertising caption, so the visual and message can support the same customer-facing idea.
items.receive: One product advertising image + One Facebook or Instagram advertising caption.

sections.name: 7. Benefits / What You Get
sections.title: Useful creative assets, ready for your next step.

items.title: A visual made for a purpose
items.text: The image is developed around the product and the intended use — not just decorated to look attractive.

items.title: A message shaped around the customer
items.text: Ad captions and product descriptions connect product information to reasons a potential buyer may care about.

items.title: Flexible service selection
items.text: Order an image, a caption, a product description, or a combination. You do not have to buy services you do not need.

items.title: A more coordinated creative process
items.text: Get product visuals and written content from one place instead of coordinating separate providers for every asset.

items.title: Content prepared for your intended use

items.title: Better value when you combine services

sections.name: 8. How It Works
sections.title: From your product photos to finished content.

items.title: Choose what you need
items.text: Select product images, ad captions, product descriptions, or the combined ad package. Add as many items as your project requires.

items.title: Send your product information
items.text: Provide your product photos, product details, target audience if known, brand references, and where you plan to use the content.

items.title: We create your order
items.text: We develop the agreed images and/or copy based on the information and direction you provide.
items.meta: Typical delivery: 1–3 working days, depending on order size and complexity.

items.title: Review your files
items.text: Receive your finished work through a download link. If something needs adjusting within the agreed brief, you can request revisions.

sections.name: 9. What We Need From You
sections.title: A good brief helps us create work that fits your product.
sections.intro: You do not need to write a complicated creative brief. Send what you have.
requiredItems: A clear product photo or the source images you want us to use
Product name and a short explanation of what it is
Where you plan to use the finished content
helpfulItems: Target customer, if you have one in mind
Brand colors, fonts, or visual references
Required image dimensions or platform specifications
Any words, claims, or visual details that must be included or avoided
sections.closingNote: If you are unsure about the creative direction, tell us what you want the customer to notice or understand. We can use that as a starting point.

sections.name: 11. Trust / Expectations
sections.title: Clear work. Clear scope. No magic promises.
sections.intro: We want you to know what you are ordering and what to expect.

items.title: The product remains the focus.
items.text: The creative should present your actual product, not replace it with something misleading.

items.title: The work follows the brief.
items.text: Your product details, intended audience, and usage help guide the creative direction.

items.title: You know what is included.
items.text: Each service lists its deliverable, and your selected order shows the items you have chosen.

items.title: You can request revisions.
items.text: Two rounds of revisions are included, subject to the agreed brief and revision policy.

items.title: We do not promise sales results.
items.text: We create images and copy. We cannot control your pricing, offer, audience, campaign settings, competition, or the customer's final decision.

sections.name: 12. FAQ
sections.title: Questions & Answers
sections.intro: Everything you need to know about ordering, briefs, files, revisions, and pricing.

items.q: What do I need to send you?
items.a: Send your product photos and a short description of what you need. It also helps to include your product details, website or product listing, intended platform, image dimensions, target customer, and any brand references you want us to follow.

items.q: Can I order only one service?
items.a: Yes. You can order a product advertising image, an advertising caption, or a product description individually. You can also choose the combined ad package or build a larger order.

items.q: What is included in the Facebook & Instagram Ad Package?
items.a: The package includes one product advertising image and one advertising caption.

The package builder calculates the discount based on the items in your order. The available discount can increase as you add eligible items, up to a maximum of 50%. Your final price and savings are displayed in the builder before checkout.
Typical delivery is 1–3 working days, depending on the number of items and the complexity of the order.
Yes. Two rounds of revisions are included. Revisions should relate to the original agreed brief. A substantially different concept or a new scope of work may require a separate order.

items.q: What file formats will I receive?
items.a: Images are delivered as JPG or PNG. Written content is delivered as DOC or TXT.

items.q: Can you make images for my specific platform?
items.a: Tell us where you intend to use the image and provide any required dimensions or specifications. We will use that information when preparing the deliverable. Platform requirements can change, so please provide any exact technical specifications that are important to your campaign.

items.q: Will the images increase my sales or ad performance?
items.a:
We cannot guarantee that. Advertising results depend on many factors beyond the creative itself, including the product, price, offer, audience, competition, landing page, and campaign setup.

Our job is to create product visuals and copy that communicate the product more clearly and give you creative material to use and test.

items.q: Do I need to provide an advertising concept?
items.a: No. If you already have a direction, share it with us. If not, tell us about the product, the customer, and what you want the content to communicate. We can develop a suitable creative direction within the agreed scope.

items.q: Can you follow my existing brand style?
items.a: Share your website, brand guidelines, or visual references. We can use them to guide the work. Please identify any elements that must remain consistent.
Payment methods currently listed are PayPal and bank transfer.

items.q: What if my product photo is low quality?
items.a: Send the photo before ordering if you are unsure. The quality and detail of the source material can affect what is possible. We will let you know if the image is unsuitable or if better source material is needed.

items.q: Do you work with every type of product?
items.a: Send us the product category and a link or photo so we can assess whether it is a suitable fit. We should confirm suitability before accepting an order that requires specialist knowledge, regulated claims, or visual details we cannot reliably reproduce.
